I posted a reply in #coastal-team to you, Bettina. I can't set up the recurring Monday 08:00 digest from here. My tools have no scheduler, and a local Hermes cron job wouldn't post back into this channel, so nothing is scheduled.

I can post a "Coastal week ahead" digest by hand whenever you ask me in this channel, drawing on #coastal-team and #coastal-random. Someone with scheduling access would need to set up the Monday recurrence.
